title: NINA Meridian Flip Failure Queue
dataSources: NINA sequences (`nina:sequence`), NINA autofocus runs (`nina:autofocus`), Ekos scheduler and device events (`ekos:scheduler`, `ekos:device`), PHD2 guiding telemetry (`phd2:guide`), plate solves (`platesolve:run`), filter wheel events (`filterwheel:event`), and flat frames (`flatlib:frame`).
app: Astrophotography session telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, PHD2, plate-solving tools, ASCOM gear, and filter-wheel controllers sent to Splunk HEC via logs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nina:sequence
| stats count(eval(meridian_flip_status="failed")) as failed_flips count as sequences by mount_name
| sort 0 - failed_flips
value: Meridian flip failures can ruin a whole night, so a ranked queue helps you see whether one mount profile is the main offender.
implementation: Send meridian-flip failures events to `index=personal` and keep `mount_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of meridian-flip failures by mounts.
grandmaExplanation: It totals which mountss stand out most for meridian-flip failures.
